binary.description: Executable to launch instead of the tool's default (e.g. a wrapper script at /workspace/claude-wrapper.sh); it receives the tool's usual arguments. A command name or path without whitespace, quotes or shell metacharacters. Defaults to the tool name if not set.

pre_launch.description: Shell commands run inside the container, in order, before the tool starts in `coi shell` — e.g. ["claude update"] to keep the agent current without rebuilding the image. They run as the container user in the workspace and their output shows in the session. Each command gets 5 minutes; a failing or slow command is reported and the tool starts anyway, and Ctrl+C skips the remaining commands. Unlike `binary` (which replaces the tool's executable), these run before it. Honored only from your own config (~/.coi/config.toml, $COI_CONFIG, ~/.coi/profiles), never from a project's .coi/config.toml or project profiles.

permission_mode.description: Permission mode: "bypass" (default) skips interactive prompts; "interactive" prompts the user

context_file.description: Path to a custom context Markdown file injected into the tool (supports ~ expansion)

auto_context.description: Automatically inject the Coi sandbox context into the tool's native system (default: true)

context_json.description: Write a machine-readable ~/SANDBOX_CONTEXT.json alongside the .md for programmatic consumers (default: true; set false to disable)

context_json_file.description: Path to a custom context JSON file injected verbatim instead of the generated ~/SANDBOX_CONTEXT.json (supports ~ expansion)
